original: 何かさ〜、カイルとロイド\n最近やけにノリが良くない？
traducao: Hey, don't Kyle and Lloyd seem\nawfully hyped up lately?

original: 前からそういうところあったけど、\n若干暑苦しいっていうか……
traducao: They were always kinda like that,\nbut it's getting a bit stifling...

original: それはノーテン菌に感染したな
traducao: They've caught the carefree germ.

original: ノーテン菌！？　\n何それ？
traducao: The carefree germ!?\nWhat's that?

original: 俺の知り合いが発見した\n人間に寄生する恐ろしい菌だ
traducao: It's a terrifying germ an acquaintance\nfound that parasitizes humans.

original: 感染した人間は\nノリと勢いだけで、人生を\nユカイに生きようとしちまうんだ
traducao: Infected people try to live merrily,\nrunning through life purely on\nhyper mood and momentum.

original: ひぃ〜〜〜！！　\n何その恐ろしい菌！\n一体発生源は何なのさ？
traducao: Eeeeek!!\nWhat kind of scary germ is that!?\nWhere does it even come from?

original: あっ……どうしよう
traducao: Ah... What should I do?

original: このミソ、賞味期限が一週間過ぎてる。\n今あるの、これだけなのに……
traducao: This miso is one week past its expiry.\nAnd it's the only one we have left...

original: 大丈夫だよコハク！\nミソは発酵食品なんだからさ
traducao: It's fine, Kohaku!\nMiso is a fermented food, after all.

original: 一週間くらい、別にど〜って事ないよ！
traducao: A week or so is no big deal at all!

original: うん……そうだよね
traducao: Yeah... you're right.

original: 食べ物は大事にしないとね！
traducao: We have to treat food with care!

original: うん！
traducao: Yeah!

original: ……ねえ、ヒスイ？\nノーテン菌の発生源ってもしかして……
traducao: ...Hey, Hisui? Could the source of\nthat carefree germ possibly be...

original: こっ、コハクは関係ねえぞ！？
traducao: K-Kohaku has nothing to do with it!?

original: ノーテン菌を振りまいてんのは、\nあのバカ一人だけなんだからなッ！
traducao: The only one spreading that carefree\ngerm is that one idiot!!

original: そういやお前、兄弟がいるんだってな？
traducao: Come to think of it, you have siblings?

original: おう。\n兄弟ってか、姉貴が一人な
traducao: Yeah.\nWell, one older sister, to be exact.

original: チェスターには妹がいるんだろ？
traducao: You have a younger sister, Chester?

original: ああ。\nアミィっていうんだ。\n我が妹ながら、年の割りにしっかり者でさ
traducao: Yeah.\nHer name is Ami.\nShe's quite mature for her age.

original: 兄の欲目を差し引いても\n結構可愛いんだぜ
traducao: Even without brotherly bias,\nshe's pretty darn cute, y'know.

original: それを言うなら、おれの姉貴も\n我が姉ながら出来た人でさ
traducao: If it comes to that, my big sister is\nquite an impressive woman herself.

original: 度胸はあるし、料理は上手いし
traducao: She's got guts and she's a great cook!

original: だったら、\n俺の妹のコハクも負けてないぜ
traducao: In that case, my little sister\nKohaku won't lose to either!

original: 器量良し、性格良し、脚力良し！\n悪い虫を追い払うのが大変だぜぇ
traducao: Great looks, great heart, great kicks!\nKeeping bad bugs away is tough work!

original: あー、そっか。\nコハクとヒスイは兄妹だったんだよな
traducao: Ah, right.\nKohaku and Hisui are siblings, huh.

original: こんな似てねえ兄妹も珍しいな
traducao: Pretty rare to see siblings so unlike.

original: へっ！　\n言ってろ
traducao: Heh!\nKeep talking.

original: とにかく、そんじょそこらの姉や妹とは\n次元が違うってぇか、まぁ\nぶっちゃけ、負ける気がしねえな
traducao: Anyway, she's on a whole other level\nfrom common sisters. Frankly speaking,\nI don't feel like losing at all.

original: 何だと？
traducao: What did you say?

original: 姉貴を馬鹿にすんのか！？
traducao: Are you mocking my sister!?

original: 馬鹿にはしてねえ。\n格が違……
traducao: I'm not mocking her.\nShe's in a different lea--

original: 上等じゃねえか！\n表へ出ろ！
traducao: Fine by me!\nStep outside!

original: 本当の格上ってのがどんなもんか\n思い知らせてやるぜ！
traducao: We'll teach you what true\nsuperiority looks like!

original: はっ……面白ぇ
traducao: Ha... Sounds fun.

original: その勝負……、\n受けて立ってやる！
traducao: I'll gladly accept\nthat challenge!

original: トラクタービーム！
traducao: Tractor Beam!

original: ほんっとチェスターってば、\nいつまでたってもシスコンなんだから
traducao: Chester, you really are a hopeless\nsister-complex brat through and through!

original: 少しは妹離れしなさいよね！　全く
traducao: Learn to let go of your sister already!

original: こ、このじゃじゃ馬女……！
traducao: Y-You wild tomboy...!

original: っていうか、おれ達……
traducao: Wait, why are we...

original: 巻き添えかよ、くそっ……
traducao: Dragged into this too, dammit...

original: ヒスイ……。\nオレ、大変な事に気が付いちゃったよ
traducao: Hisui...\nI just realized something terrible.

original: 何だぁ？　\n急に
traducao: What is it?\nAll of a sudden.

original: どうせ、くだらねぇ事だろ
traducao: It's probably something stupid anyway.

original: ううん、違うんだ！
traducao: No, not at all!

original: 子どもの頃から、村で何度も聞かされた\nおとぎ話……覚えてる？
traducao: Do you remember that fairy tale we heard\nin our village over and over as kids?

original: ああ、ねむり姫の話か？
traducao: Yeah, the Sleeping Princess story?

original: 緋色の髪の魔王が出て来て\nどうのとかいう
traducao: The one about the scarlet-haired\nDemon Lord or whatever.

original: そう、それだよ！\nオレ、その魔王を見つけたんだ
traducao: Yes, that's the one!\nI found that Demon Lord.

original: もしかしたら、そいつ……\nこの船の中にいるかもしれない
traducao: Could it be that he is...\non board this very ship?

original: おいおい、そりゃマジな話なのか？
traducao: Hey now, are you serious about that?

original: 一体どいつが……
traducao: Just who the hell is it...

original: シッ！　\n来たよ、隠れて！！
traducao: Shh!\nHe's here, hide!!

original: ホラね！
traducao: See!

original: 顔も極悪そうだし\n服装だって魔王っぽい……
traducao: His face looks totally evil, and his\noutfit looks just like a Demon Lord...

original: バカ野郎！　\nありゃ、こないだ来た\nライマ国の王子だよッ
traducao: You dumbass!\nThat's the prince of Lima\nwho arrived recently!

original: 今の発言を聞かれでもしてみろ。\nお前、間違いなく処刑されるぞ
traducao: If he heard what you just said,\nyou would definitely be executed!

original: え……魔王様じゃなくて王子様？\nそれは大変……
traducao: Wait... A prince, not a demon lord?\nThat's even worse...

original: ヤイオ　スンントゥ　ティイ\nアエヌン　エ　グディンエティ\nエトゥイオムティ
traducao: Yaio sunntu tii\naenun e gudin'eti\netuiomti.

original: うん、今のはもうわかるぞ
traducao: Yes, I can understand that one now.

original: 「あなたは\n　たくさんの\n　知識がありそうです」
traducao: 'You seem to have\n a great deal of\n knowledge.'

original: ワイール！　正解よ
traducao: Waa-i-ru! Correct!

original: キールすごいな。\nどんどん言葉覚える！
traducao: Keele is amazing!\nLearning words so fast!

original: これくらい、出来て当然さ
traducao: Being able to do this is only natural.

original: あらゆる資料を読み解く為に\nどんな言語にも精通しておく\n必要があるからな
traducao: To decipher all kinds of materials,\nit is essential to be well-versed\nin every single language.

original: おい、コハク
traducao: Hey, Kohaku.

original: 今の聞いたべか？\n世んの中にゃ、色んな言葉さ\nあんだっぺなぁ！
traducao: Didja hear that?\nThere's all kinds of tongues\nin this world, ain't there!

original: んだ、んだぁ。\nおらもおんどろいただよぉ。\nえんれぇ難しい言葉だぁ
traducao: Aye, aye.\nSurprised me too, big bro.\nMighty difficult tongue, that is.

original: んだども、メルデーがしゃべっと\nめんこいだよぉ
traducao: Even so, when Meredy speaks it,\nit's mighty cute!

original: ワイール！\nキール、めんこいて何てコトバか？
traducao: Waa-i-ru!\nKeele, what word is 'menkoi'?

original: ぼくに聞くな！\nあんな言葉は聞いた事がない
traducao: Don't ask me!\nI've never heard such a word!

original: ん？\nキール、どんなコトバもわかる。\n違うのか？
traducao: Hm?\nKeele understands all words.\nIs that not so?

original: くっ……。\nそ、それは……
traducao: Guh...\nTh-That is...

original: ぼ、ぼくにも色々事情があるんだ！
traducao: I-I have my reasons too!
Aaaaaaaaaah...
Aaaaaaaaaah...

original: 何か変なものでも、食べたんですか？
traducao: Did you eat something strange?

original: 気を付けた方がいいですよ、\nゆるんだ顔が、\n余計ゆるんで見えますから
traducao: You should be careful.\nYour slack face looks\neven slacker than usual.

original: ぷっ！　\nな〜に、その顔
traducao: Pfft!\nWhat's with that face?

original: にらめっこの練習？　\n程々にね〜
traducao: Practicing for a staring contest?\nKeep it in moderation~

original: キュッポ兄さん、\nあれは何してるんだキュ？
traducao: Kyuppo-bro,\nwhat is he doing, kyu?

original: あれは、虫を食べようとしてるキュ。\n図鑑で、そういう植物を見たキュ
traducao: He's trying to eat bugs, kyu.\nI saw plants like that in a book, kyu.

original: だから大きな口を開けて、\n動かずにいるんだキュ？
traducao: Is that why he's holding his big mouth\nopen without moving, kyu?

original: そうだキュ。\nかわいそうだから助けてあげるキュ
traducao: That's right, kyu.\nI feel sorry for him, let's help, kyu!

original: わかったキュ！
traducao: Understood, kyu!

original: 助けるキュ！
traducao: Let's help, kyu!

original: だー、やめろー！！
traducao: Gah, stop it--!!
Kyuuuuuuuuu!!!

original: 全く、どいつもこいつも、\n好き勝手言いやがって……
traducao: Dammit, each and every one of you\nrunning your mouths...

original: 結局、くしゃみ\n出なかったじゃねぇか……
traducao: In the end, my sneeze didn't\neven come out...

original: なぁ……。\nジュディスのその頭だけどよ。\nそれって、髪の毛なのか？
traducao: Hey...\nAbout that head of yours, Judith.\nIs that actually hair?

original: ええ、もちろん。\n髪を結っているだけよ
traducao: Yes, of course.\nI just have my hair tied up.

original: へぇ〜。\nじゃあ、結構な長さだな
traducao: Whoa.\nThen it's pretty long, huh.

original: んで、ほどくとどれくらいになるんだ？
traducao: So how long is it when you let it down?

original: あら。\nそんな事が知りたいの？
traducao: Oh my.\nYou want to know that?

original: 教えてあげてもいいけれど……。\nそうだわ、お風呂に入ろうと思ってたから、\n一緒に行って確かめてみる？
traducao: I wouldn't mind telling you, but...\nI was just about to take a bath,\nso want to come see for yourself?

original: ば！　\nいや！！　\nちょ！！！
traducao: Wh--!\nNo!!\nWait---!!!

original: コ……、コハクのとこ行かねえと！
traducao: I-I gotta go see Kohaku!

original: うふふ。\n何を想像したのかしら？
traducao: Ufufu.\nWhatever did you imagine, I wonder?

original: アスベルって、\n自然体でソフィの面倒見てるよなぁ
traducao: Asbel naturally looks after Sophie,\ndoesn't he?

original: もしかして、元々\n兄弟でもいるのか？
traducao: Do you have siblings\nof your own?

original: ああ、弟が一人な
traducao: Yeah, one younger brother.

original: へぇ〜、お前、長男だったのか。\n何か意外だな
traducao: Whoa, you're the eldest brother?\nThat's kinda unexpected.

original: よく言われるよ。\n弟の方が出来がいいって……
traducao: I get told that a lot.\nThat my brother is the capable one...

original: それなら、オレだって\nアミィの方が気が利くって言われるぜ
traducao: If it's that, people tell me Ami\nis much more attentive than I am.

original: はっ、情けねぇな、お前ら。\nそんなんで恥ずかしくねえのかよ？
traducao: Ha, pathetic, you two.\nAren't you embarrassed about that?

original: 何だよ、随分な言い草だな。\nそういうお前はどうなんだよ？
traducao: Hey, that's rich coming from you.\nWhat about you then?

original: もちろん、俺はどっからどう見ても\n頼りになる兄貴だって言われてるぜ？
traducao: Naturally, anyone would tell you\nI'm a reliable big brother!

original: 故郷でも、それはそれは評判で……
traducao: Back in our hometown, my reputation was...

original: 失礼した……
traducao: My apologies...

original: あ？　\n何だよ、いきなり
traducao: Huh?\nWhat's with you all of a sudden?

original: 今まで、コハクが\n姉君だと思っていたのでな
traducao: Until now, I had assumed Kohaku\nwas your older sister.

original: はぁ……
traducao: *sigh*...

original: （泳ぎ……、\n　セネルに教わった方がいいのか……？\n　クソッ、何か格好つかねえな……）
traducao: (Swimming... Should I have\n Senel teach me...? Dammit,\n that's so uncool...)

original: はぁ……
traducao: *sigh*...

original: 何だ……クロエじゃねえか
traducao: Oh, it's just you, Chloe.

original: どうした、随分でかいため息だな
traducao: What's wrong? That's quite a deep sigh.

original: ハーツか……
traducao: Hearts, is it...

original: いや、実は……少々、困った事に\n巻き込まれそうになっていてな……
traducao: No, the truth is... I might get dragged\ninto a somewhat troublesome situation...

original: 困った事？　\n何かあったのか
traducao: Troublesome situation?\nDid something happen?

original: いや、別に大した事では\nないんだが……
traducao: No, it isn't really\nsuch a big deal, but...

original: ……なあ、例えば、だぞ
traducao: ...Say, for instance.

original: ……海へ行きたがらない女というのは\nお……男から見て、どう映るものなのだ
traducao: ...How does a woman who dislikes going\nto the sea appear... to a m-man?

original: はぁ？　\n何だそりゃ
traducao: Hah?\nWhat kind of question is that?

original: ……す、すまない。\n今の話は無かった事に……
traducao: ...F-Forgive me.\nForget I said anything...

original: 別に、いいんじゃねえ？\n海が好きな奴もいれば、\nそうでもない奴だっているだろ
traducao: Who cares?\nSome people like the sea,\nand some people don't.

original: ちなみに俺は、\n海はあんまり好きじゃねえ
traducao: For the record, I'm not very fond\nof the sea myself.

original: ほ、本当か？
traducao: R-Really?

original: じ……実は、私も……なんだ
traducao: Th-The truth is, neither am I...

original: へえ、奇遇だな？
traducao: Heh, what a coincidence.

original: 見る分にはいいんだが、こう……。\nその、泳いだりとかはちょっと……な？
traducao: Looking at it is fine, but... you know,\nswimming and all is just kinda... right?

original: ああ
traducao: Yeah.

original: あの、息のしづらい感じが\nどうにも苦手というか……な？
traducao: That suffocating feeling of not being able\nto breathe is just uncomfortable... right?

original: だよな？
traducao: Right?

original: ……驚いた。\nこんな身近に、\n嗜好の似た人間がいたとはな
traducao: ...I am surprised.\nTo think someone so close\nshares such similar tastes.

original: 何にしろ、無理して行く事は\nねえと思うぜ？\n楽しめねえなら、損するだけだろ
traducao: Either way, no need to force yourself!\nIf you can't enjoy it,\nit's just a waste of time.

original: ……そう、だな。\nそうだよな
traducao: ...Yes, indeed.\nYou are right.

original: 感謝するぞ、ハーツ
traducao: You have my thanks, Hearts.

original: あ、お兄ちゃん！
traducao: Ah, big bro!

original: ねえねえ、今度みんなで一緒に\n海に行こうよ∀
traducao: Hey, hey, let's all go to the sea\ntogether sometime! :)
